::: {.hero}
# Kitchin Research Group

::: {.who}
John Kitchin · Department of Chemical Engineering, Carnegie Mellon University
:::

::: {.lead}
We use data science and machine learning to solve problems in catalysis and
chemical engineering, from machine-learned potentials for molecular simulation to
optimization and design of experiments for high-throughput experimentation.
:::

## Research

::: {.cards}
::: {.card-item}
### Machine-learned potentials
Neural network potentials trained on quantum chemical calculations, and how
uncertain their predictions are.

[More →](research.qmd){.more}
:::

::: {.card-item}
### Catalysis
Alloy and oxide catalysts, electrocatalysis, and dynamic catalysis with
periodically modulated binding energies.

[More →](research.qmd){.more}
:::

::: {.card-item}
### Optimization and automation
Solvers for nonlinear and mixed-integer problems, differentiable programming,
and automated experiments.

[More →](research.qmd){.more}
:::
:::
